description: One record per question only after the original RPSC paper has been downloaded, fingerprinted, text-extracted and human-verified.

required_fields.paper_record_id: Must match a record_id in manifest.json.
required_fields.exam_cycle: Official exam cycle label (not the year the paper was released).
required_fields.question_no_as_printed: Preserve number printed on original paper.
required_fields.question_text_verbatim: Verbatim text; preserve spellings where legible and annotate uncertain OCR instead of silently correcting.
required_fields.options_verbatim: Ordered options A/B/C/D or equivalent; null for descriptive questions.
required_fields.official_key_answer: Final/revised official key response; null if descriptive/no key identified.
required_fields.key_status: Final, Revised, Model, Provisional, Not Applicable, or Not Located.
required_fields.primary_chapter: One of chapters 01–37 after human review.
required_fields.secondary_chapters: List of additional supported chapter IDs.
required_fields.syllabus_unit: Relevant official syllabus unit/paper, where supported.
required_fields.source_pdf_filename: Exact local filename of untouched RPSC original.
required_fields.extraction_method: Native text extraction, OCR, or manual transcription.
required_fields.human_verified: Boolean; true only after comparison with rendered source page.
required_fields.review_notes: Deleted question, revised key, unclear print, translation variance, or other caveat.

policy: Do not populate question text from memory or coaching summaries when official text is missing.
Do not overwrite a provisional key with a final key; preserve key version history.
Question numbers and option order must match the official paper.
Tagging must be based on question substance, not keyword matching alone.
No topic-frequency totals before all papers in the selected denominator have been fully processed and checked.
